facts.fact: In late October 2025 the Gabonese government began a pilot to digitize social and tax payments, with full deployment scheduled for January 2026 (Ecofin Agency).

GAB.note: Only counts of mobile money accounts, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy reported 4.5 million mobile money accounts at end-2024, 1.6 million active, with operators processing 368.3 million transactions worth CFA4,087 billion in 2024; MaDigiPaie lets citizens pay by mobile money by scanning a GIMACPAY QR code (Ecofin Agency).

systems.owner: Government of Gabon with BEAC / GIMAC

facts.fact: In late October 2025 the Gabonese government began a pilot to digitize social and tax payments, with full deployment scheduled for January 2026; earlier in 2025 it engaged Visa to modernize tax collection (Ecofin Agency).
facts.system: digitization of social and tax payments

facts.fact: On 21 November 2025 the Gabonese government launched a project to digitize payments for e-visa applications (Ecofin Agency).
